name: @local/dsh-ac-boot
description: A cinematic four-beat opening sequence for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, painted with Agnes key art in an aerial-combat briefing style. v0.13.0 rebuilds the animation around four original generated backdrops (mission table, carrier launch, storm climb, sunset title), serves them from the Host under /acb/assets, and fixes the v0.12 startup incompatibility: the Host half now declares its webServer dependency, never touches the workspace registry, and contributes only the pre-boot splash plus a tiny read-only asset route. The launch-scoped one-shot behaviour from 0.12.0 is preserved (wake from sleep, tray restore and page reload never replay the sequence).
